integrity: All finite assertions reproducible by two self-contained exact-integer implementations with independent codebook generation in the C++ implementation; software and inputs supplied in full.
limitations: Finite exact classification of rooted binary order-four de Bruijn words only; no higher-order spectrum or independent mathematical validation claimed. Older unindexed spectra are a priority risk.
title: Exact Walsh recovery and sharp endpoint projection for the binary order-four de Bruijn codebook
